english: They said nothing was turned in\nat the police box.
Even filing a lost-property report\ndidn't help…
A 'rock-throw' report?\nWhat's that got to do with lost stuff?
It's 'ishitsubutsu,' Haruka.\nIt means lost property.
Huh? Oh, right. Of course~!\nEhehe…
I was hoping whoever picked it up\nwould turn it in…
Whoever picked it up…
Ah!!\nMaybe those girls picked it up!
Those girls…?
Just before I realized I'd dropped the Poketen,\nI met two girls in the park. They said\nthey came from Italy's pizza tower, or something…
You mean the Leaning Tower of Pisa.\nIf they're from Italy,\nthey're not from Japan?
Hmm, I dunno?\nTheir Japanese was really good, though.\nI wonder where they are now…
You met them in the park, right?\nHave you searched that park already?
I searched once, but maybe\nTesura and Nine will come again!\nLet's go!
// Scene change\n// Background: the park
Hmm, nobody…
If only we knew how to contact them.
Yeah… I was in a hurry,\nso we parted without exchanging anything.
We promised to go to a café next time,\nbut I didn't even ask for their contact info…\nUgh, what a blunder~.
They might not even live in this town…\nIt might be difficult…
What do I do… if I can never\ntransform again…
Haruka, don't be so down.\nThere's got to be some way.
But if I can't transform,\nI can't call myself a Twin Angel~!
…Do you know how many generations\nof Twin Angels there have been, counting us?
Huh? Which generation…?
Hmm, I don't really know, but\nit's been going on since long ago, right?\nThey were called Amanotsukai, or something.
Yes. So how do you think\nthe Heaven's Messengers transformed back then?
Huh… ah!?\nThe Poketen's a machine, so it didn't exist\nback then, right? How did they transform???
Exactly. Not having the Poketen\ndoesn't mean you can't transform.
Then if I practice transforming,\ncould I become a Twin Angel\nwithout the Poketen?
It's possible. If you can transform,\nyou might even sense where the Poketen is…?
Aoi! I'll do my best!\nI'll show you I can transform\nwithout the Poketen!
Yes! …Still, not knowing where\nthe Poketen is remains a problem.\nWe have to find it somehow…
R-right. It's something really important…
Yes. Haruka, I'll practice with you.\nLet's do our best!
Aoi… thank you…!
// Tesura and Nine watching from the shadows
They can transform without the Poketen…?\nThey can become Twin Angels\nwithout this…?
Unexpected.
If that's really true, holding on to this\nis meaningless… no, there may still\nbe a use for it…
Sis…
// Fade to black; time passes\n// Background: the park (night)
Let's go, fever time!
Lovely Angel!
Teei!
Haaah!
Ugh, no good at all~.\nI'm not getting that surging-power feeling\nlike usual!
Indeed…\nDoesn't feel like it'll work at all.\nMaybe there's a trick to it…
A trick… I wonder what kind of trick?
If we could figure out what's different\nfrom transforming with the Poketen's power…
Right! Hmm, but what IS different?
The power of the Heaven's Messengers—\nthe heart of justice—should be within us.\nIf we can awaken it, surely…
// Kurumi comes looking for Haruka and Aoi
Harukaaa! Aoi!
Kurumi? What's wrong?
Enemies! Tons of them showed up\nright in the middle of Akihabara!
At a time like this…!
Transform right away and let's go!
Well, um… actually, right now\nwe can't transform.
Huh? What do you mean?
I dropped the Poketen somewhere,\nand so…
Whaaat!? Honestly, what are you doing!\nLosing the Poketen is beyond lacking awareness!\nYou dummy dummy dummy!!
Kurumi, we can't stand around.\nWe need to evacuate the townspeople, quickly!
Tch, you're right.\nBut if you can't transform, what do we do…!
Then I'll do Aoi's share\nand useless-Haruka's share too!!
Don't overdo it.\nTsubasa and the others are here too…
Right!
// Kurumi runs off.\n// Kurumi transformation movie
Here I go!\nWhite Angel, attivazione!
// Battle map: Akihabara (night)\n// White Angel appears where the grunts are deployed. Only White Angel in the initial allied deployment.
Come on, come at me from anywhere!
I hope Kurumi'll be okay…
Everyone should arrive soon.\nLet's believe in Kurumi…!
Yeah.
I have to hold it together…\nfulfill my duty as a Heaven's Messenger,\nas a Twin Angel!
// Turn 2: the Black Twin Angels appear
Chaha! Piece of cake!
// Black Red Angel, Black Blue Angel, and Black White Angel appear near Kurumi
Huh!? What!?
Let it all break…
I won't aim for the center…\nwho cares what I hit or where!
No way… Aoi? Haruka?\nWhat ARE you people!!
Fakes…!\nJust like with Shirayuki!\nThey're fakes of us!!
Like the fakes of Tsubasa and Hibiki\nthat Chris fought? If that's what these are…!!
Kurumi, run!! Those enemies are…!!
Don't be stupid!\nIf I run here, who'll fight!
They say those things have power\njust like ours! Fighting alone is dangerous!
Power just like the Twin Angels'…?\nThen I definitely can't run!
Why not!?
If I leave them be,\nit'll look like the Twin Angels\ndid evil deeds!
I absolutely won't allow that!!\nThe Twin Angels are guardians of justice!
(Kurumi… you care about\nthe Twin Angels that much…!)
Let's settle this, fakes!!\nNo way I'm losing to the likes of you!!
// Battle resumes\n// Twin Angel transformation event when Kurumi's HP drops below a threshold, or next turn
Ugh… they're better than I thought…!\nHonestly, I'm surprised…
Kurumi!
Kurumi! Fighting alone any more\nis dangerous!
No! I'll definitely beat these fakes!
Kurumi!
No!! The Twin Angels never lose!\nI won't run from outlaws like these!
You can't do it alone!!
Impossible? I refuse to accept that!\nThe Twin Angels always win!! I believe it!!
Impossible…!
// Kurumi is attacked. Battle animation skipped, no damage shown.
Useless…!
// Kurumi is attacked. Battle animation skipped, no damage shown.
Uwaaaaaah!!
Kurumi-san!!
...I get it. I finally get it...
Haruka-san?
Aoi-chan... I'm going to transform...!
Huh...?
I figured it out... it doesn't matter what form I take...\nThe moment I want to fight for someone else,\nI'm already a Twin Angel...!!
It's not that I can't fight because I can't transform.\nWith Kurumi-chan hurting this badly,\nit's because I won't fight that I can't transform...!!
I understand, Haruka-san... I can feel it.\nYour feelings are reaching me too...!
Transform...! I will transform!!
TRAAANSFOOORM!!
//The screen flashes.\n//Twin Angel transformation movie.\n//Red Angel and Blue Angel appear on the map.
We did it!!
We transformed!
Honestly! If you could do it, you should've done it from the start!\nI'm the only one who took a beating for nothing...!
Sorry, Kurumi-chan!
Well, I'll give you credit for trying.\nAoi-oneesama! Haruka! Time for the usual routine!
Yes! With love and courage, every shot hits its mark!
We'll take back everyone's smiles!
Phantom-Thief Angels!
Twin Angel!!!
Now... Angel Time begins!!
//Battle resumes.\n//Enemy reinforcements arrive next turn: Black White Angel and grunts appear.
Hmph... incompetent...!
Whoa, it's a fake Kurumi-chan!
Hmph! You're late!\nAnd a fake of me, of all things,\ndon't make me laugh!
Their numbers have grown quite a bit.\nWe mustn't let our guard down...!
//Allied reinforcements arrive.
Ah! There are tons of Twin Angels!
Huh? It says 'twin,' but there are three of them...\nno wait, even more than that?
Explaining's a pain, so skip it!\nWe're taking down the black ones and their gang!
Those are fakes... roger!
There's zero chance of us losing now!\nLet's finish this quick!
//Conversation event when Black Red Angel and Red Angel clash in battle.
We might look alike, but we're nothing alike.
The Twin Angels' strength...\nis way beyond that!
//When Black Red Angel is defeated.
That's enough. I'm leaving.
//Black Red Angel withdraws.
I'll never lose to bad kids like you!
//Conversation event when Black Blue Angel and Blue Angel clash in battle.
Even if our skills are equal,\nI won't lose to you!
The strength behind the arrows I loose\ndoesn't come from me alone!
//When Black Blue Angel is defeated.
Retreating...
//Black Blue Angel withdraws.
This is as far as you go.
//Conversation event when Black White Angel and White Angel clash in battle.
You're my fake, right?\nThen turn this losing battle around\nif you can! Go on, try!
You're noisy... Silence.
You can't even do that, yet you call yourself\na fake of ME...?\nYou're ten billion light-years too early!!
//When Black White Angel is defeated.
This wasn't supposed to happen...
//Black White Angel withdraws.
You're too slow coming AND going!\nJust where are you a fake of me, I wonder?\nYou're shoddy work, that's what!
//All enemies defeated: stage clear.
All right! That's about how it goes!
But just who WERE those fakes?\nIt bothers me...
I wonder if we'll end up fighting them again...
//Battle ends.\n//Background: Akihabara
Long time no see!
Sorry for making you worry!\nI'm fine now!
Thank you for looking after Aoi-san.\nAllow me to thank you as well.
You're a precious friend.\nWe've got to help each other out.
Incidentally, you call yourselves Twin Angel,\nyet why are there three of you?
I've answered that question over a hundred times already,\nso sorry, but I'll be skipping it.
No need to be stingy☆\nTell me, nyanmage?
Explaining it so YOU'D be satisfied\nwould take half a day. That okay with you?
Hmm, can't you make it a bit shorter?
Then give it up!
Aww, I'm sho~cked.
//Fade to black.\n//Background: inside the Gamers store
Nyo? There's a delivery package\nsitting here, nyo?
(Right... left...! Nobody's watching, nyo.)
//Event CG: Dejiko drooling
Mufufu, it's gotta be food, nyo!
Nobody's watching right now! I'll take it all, nyo!
Melon, nyo? Cookies, nyo?
If it's Tottori-grown broccoli,\nthat'd be the best, nyo~!!
Okay, opening it, nyo!
//Event CG off
Hm? What's this, nyo?\nIt's not food, nyo.
There's some lame-looking handheld game thingy\nand a letter inside, nyo.
Let's see... 'This belongs to Minazuki Haruka-san.\nPlease return it to her. -Nine.'\nWhat's this about, nyo???
//Fade to black.\n//Background: city (night)
...I left the package.
Thanks, Nacchan.
If that device has nothing to do with transforming,\nholding onto it could be dangerous instead.\nIf it had a tracker or something, that'd be trouble.
...Besides, it's surely\nsomething precious to Minazuki-san.
Big sis...
We may end up fighting the Twin Angels again\nin future missions, but\nthat's separate from this.
(If anything, losing that device\nmay have made the Twin Angels\neven stronger...)
//Fade to black.\n//Background: inside the Gamers store
It's my Poketen! I knew Tesla-chan and\nNine-chan picked it up for me~!
That's wonderful, Haruka-san.
But I wonder why it got delivered\nto Gamers? I wonder?
I wonder if they knew\nthat she's an acquaintance of Dejiko-chan?
There's stuff I'm curious about too, but\nfirst off, I'm glad it came back!
I want to thank those two, but\nthey didn't write any contact info...
Suspicious...
Tesla-chan and Nine-chan aren't\nsuspicious at all!\nThey even delivered my Poketen...
Yeah, yeah... You'd say\neven a scarecrow or a mannequin was a good kid, Haruka.
Ahaha! Haruka-san totally would say that!
I can totally tell a good scarecrow-san\nfrom a mannequin-san!\n...Probably.
To get through to Haruka-san,\nwouldn't you have to write 'bad scarecrow'\non their face? It'd be impossible otherwise.
I think so too~.
Aw~, even Rika-chan's being mean~.
But maybe it's precisely because she's that kind of Minazuki\nthat the kid who found it returned the lost item.
If you do good things,\ngood surely comes back to you, desu~!\nTurn disaster into wearing clothes! Desu~!
[MERU], zero points!
Hawa!?
It's that whole karma thing!\n'When it rains, the umbrella shop profits,' right?
[NOEL], zero points!
Honyah!?
No no, the proverb for times like this is,\n'A walking dog finds a bone!'\nRight, Aoi-chan!?
Um... it's really heartwarming.\nI like it.
Honestly, I don't even know\nwhere to start poking holes in that...
//END
